entities.name: PurL FGAM synthase
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Thermosynechococcus vestitus PurL Q8DIA7; length 761 aa.
Large PurL subunit of the three-component FGAM synthase complex; transfers ammonia generated by PurQ to FGAR.
Annotated EC 6.3.5.3; ATP- and magnesium-dependent activity in de novo purine biosynthesis.
Pfam domains include FGAR-AT_linker and duplicated AIRS/AIRS_C regions characteristic of long-form PurL.
Cytoplasmic; annotated complex contains one PurL, one PurQ, and two PurS subunits.

entities.name: FGAR to FGAM amidation
observations: N(2)-formyl-N(1)-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)glycinamide + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → 2-formamido-N(1)-(5-O-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)acetamidine + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + H(+).
Rhea reaction RHEA:17129; PurL catalyzes the FGAR amidation step while PurQ supplies ammonia from glutamine.

entities.name: De novo purine biosynthesis
observations: PurL participates in the pathway from FGAR toward 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole and ultimately IMP.
The reaction is the ATP-dependent FGAM synthase step of purine biosynthesis.
